correctness.rationale: At the fold rb=4m/(m+c)^2, rho=(m-c)/(2m) in (0,1/2), a=1-rho, exact normalization F(x)=x(1-(x-rho)^2/a^2) gives monotone F(x)<=x and crossing identity F(x)-rho=(x-rho)(1-x(x-rho)/a^2). The unique upper preimage s(s-rho)=a^2 delimits the positive semistable basin [rho,s]; reciprocal parabolic increments give n(x_n-rho)->a^2/rho for rho<x0<s. Below fold F_eps=(1-eps)F and all physical orbits extinct. Scaling u=a sqrt(eps) v gives dv/dtau=-(1+v^2), tau=(rho/a)sqrt(eps)n. Outer monotone bounded-time estimates and a two-stage small cutoff justify pi, pi/2 or zero passage clock, and F'(s)=rho/s-2 maps x0=s+zeta sqrt(eps) to the boxed arctan initial condition. Independently confirmed symbolic polynomial identities and nine numerical crossover cases at eps=1e-8; numerical checks are not the limiting proof.
